title: Add produce_and_verify ordering characterization test (R0)
summary: Add one new test in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs that drives a fake job through produce_and_verify and asserts the order of ui.line output and the invocation sequence numbers. Add a CHANGELOG entry. No behavior change, no other test edited. The audience is the structure-pass owner, who needs R5-R8 guarded on ordering.

defaults_applied.how: New test, with cargo test and clippy passing.
Test asserts ordering behavior, not wiring.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The test goes in the existing tests module of run.rs, reusing existing fake-job helpers where possible.
The section 5 move-proof items hold vacuously since R0 moves nothing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test --locked: a new test drives a fake job through produce_and_verify and passes; it asserts the exact order of ui.line output and the invocation numbers.
The diff only adds one test (plus helpers it needs) in run.rs; no existing test and no non-test code is changed, and the earlier test list is unchanged except for the one new name.
The test would fail if closing.baseline were set after the producer instead of before (the check in design doc section 5, R0 row); the report says how this was established.
cargo fmt --all --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the new characterization test.
Only the files run.rs and CHANGELOG.md change; nothing is moved, so the section 5 move proof (re-exports, caller checks) holds trivially and the report states that.

departures: Needs a fake job harness inside a very large run.rs, so slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than reference.
